title: Student accounts
description: Issue university accounts and manage student identity and access.
resetDescription: Issue a new unique password for {{name}}? Their current password will stop working. Give the new credentials directly to the student.
generatedPasswordNote: A unique password and university ID will be generated when you create this account. You can copy the credentials to give to the student.
credentialsDescription: Copy these credentials now. The password will not be shown again after you close this window.
copyError: Copy is unavailable. Select the email and password fields to copy them manually.
handoverNote: Give this email and password directly to the student. Only an administrator can change their name, email, or password.
emailTaken: This email address already belongs to another university account.
